title: USF-1086 Dev Compose Provider Dependency and Profile Matrix
authorityBoundary: This matrix is a lower-authority supporting map. It is lower authority than the compose manifests, the compose-service catalogue, the semantic contracts, and the v2 semantic graph. It records dev-compose provider dependency, profile, startup/teardown, readiness, port, secret and cleanup boundaries only, and asserts no live-provider, staging, production, supplier, deployment or compliance readiness.
scopeNote: Covers the 40 compose-service catalogue providers across all classes (canonical-dev-compose, profile-gated, test-staging-live-only, deferred, out-of-foundation-scope), including paired/consolidated providers that keep distinct runtime responsibilities. The consolidation map's additional not-found placeholder carries no runtime dependency or profile semantics and is intentionally not modelled here.

evidenceScoping.statement: Provider readiness is scoped and never global. Compose start, health and readiness success prove only the scoped dev-compose fact and none of the non-claims above.

providers.profileMembership: default (no compose profile; started on every dev bootstrap)
providers.profileGatingCondition: always-on in the default dev compose project (no profile gate)
startupPrerequisites: USF compose project network available (no service dependency)
providers.healthCondition: compose healthcheck (CMD-SHELL pg_isready -U foundation_app -d foundation ...); healthy on exit 0
providers.readinessCondition: ready only when this provider's own health signal passes within the active dev-compose profile; no health-gated dependency; dev-compose scope only
teardownPrerequisites: torn down after dependents pgbackrest, temporal have stopped
providers.cleanupResponsibility: named volume(s) postgres-data retained across runs; operator resets via 'compose down -v'; synthetic data only

portBoundary.semantic: semantic host boundary for postgres; host port numbers are operational metadata, not authority

providers.proofObligation: dev realisation must prove environment-scoped policy compliance.
